product_one_liner.value: Aviatrix’s Cloud Native Security Fabric modernizes and secures multicloud infrastructure for enterprises.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists free-tier and per-workload prices.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index is a general technical/marketing insights blog and does not establish two build-focused posts authored by engineers.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site includes deployment, configuration, security, monitoring, API-reference and release-note materials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open careers pages show engineering and sales roles, but no currently listed role title containing AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM or computer vision.

model_provider.notes: No publicly named AI model or model provider was established in the product documentation, blog, security material or subprocessor material reviewed.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names SOC 2 and ISO 27001; TISAX is not one of the certification categories requested.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was announced in September 2021, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Senior Inside Sales Representative posting is available.

launched_6mo.notes: Aviatrix announced Clearance on 2026-10-26, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Willie Tejada was appointed GM for Cloud Native Security Fabric on 2025-08-05; his current profile identifies him as GM & SVP at Aviatrix.
